title: PPM AI Compute-Economy Contracts
description: Structures for the caching / reuse / learning layer that sits behind the AIPort: cache entries and their dependency fingerprints, per-task cache policy, human feedback (the label stream), the learned-model registry, and the resolution result recorded for every request.

ResolutionTier.description: Which tier of the resolution ladder actually served a request.

CacheDependency.description: One edge of a cache entry's dependency fingerprint. Derived from the output's grounded_on plus the task input's declared fields. Queried by the event-driven invalidation handler.

field.description: The specific field consumed, when known, enabling field-level invalidation (e.g. 'estimate' invalidates a WSJF score but not a summary).

version.description: Version/updated_at of the entity at cache time; a change means stale.

CacheEntry.description: A stored AI result, keyed by content. Cached at the atomic grain of the task (per message, per driver), not the whole assembled request.

grain.description: The atomic unit this entry represents, for incremental reuse (e.g. 'email_message:THREAD-9', 'driver:cost_variance').

output.description: The stored task output (already validated against its ai-tasks.schema output contract).

model_version.description: LLM or learned-model version that produced this, so a model upgrade can invalidate en masse.

embedding.description: Normalized-input embedding; present only when the task opts into the semantic tier.

tokens_saved.description: Cumulative tokens avoided by reuse of this entry.

stale.description: Marked by the invalidation handler; a stale entry is never served for a decision-bearing task.

CachePolicy.description: Per-task configuration of the resolution ladder. This is the fence that keeps semantic reuse away from flip-sensitive tasks.

tiers_enabled.description: Which tiers this task may use. Prioritization, e.g., omits 'semantic_cache'.

semantic_threshold.description: Cosine-similarity floor for a semantic reuse; high (e.g. 0.95) by design.

decompose_grain.description: The atomic unit for incremental reuse, e.g. 'per_message', 'per_driver', 'per_action'.

decision_bearing.description: If true, never serve a stale entry; recompute on any doubt.

AIFeedback.description: A human verdict on an AI output — the free label stream that trains the learning layer.

edited_output.description: The corrected output when the human edited it — the highest-value label.

LearnedModel.description: Registry record for a model in the learning layer. A cache of judgment; can go stale and be rolled back.

artifact_ref.description: Where the serialized model lives (local file in the personal edition).

metrics.description: Held-out accuracy / MAE / etc., monitored against the ongoing feedback stream.

confidence_floor.description: Below this, escalate to the LLM.

active.description: Deactivate to fall back to the LLM instantly.

ResolutionResult.description: Recorded on every AI request (extends the AI_TASK log) so the compute-economy panel can report tier distribution and savings.

escalated_to_llm.description: True when a learned model was below its confidence floor and deferred.

output.summary: Vendor asks to confirm the Ledger cutover date.
